title: Ronaldo's overhead kick, Juventus v Real Madrid
competition: UEFA Champions League quarter-final, first leg
rightsNote: Sound and commentary are our own recreation from public match reports. The video is Real Madrid's official upload, played muted in YouTube's own player.

officialVideo.title: Cristiano Ronaldo's amazing bicycle kick! | Juventus 0-3 Real Madrid | Champions League (2017/18)

events.label: Real Madrid have the ball in midfield, leading 1-0.
Real Madrid pass forward, toward the far side.
Real Madrid get the ball into the Juventus box, and Juventus cannot clear.
Lucas Vázquez shoots from close range, and Gianluigi Buffon saves.
The ball runs loose, and Real Madrid keep it out on the right.
The ball reaches Dani Carvajal on the right.
Carvajal steadies it on the right.
Carvajal floats a cross in from the right.
Cristiano Ronaldo leaps with his back to goal and hits an overhead kick.
Goal. Past Gianluigi Buffon. Juventus 0, Real Madrid 2.
A split second of stunned silence in the stadium.
The Juventus home fans applaud Ronaldo.
